title.hr: Ceph grozd: CRUSH, PG-ovi, replikacija i oporavak
title.en: Ceph cluster: CRUSH, PGs, replication and recovery

concept.hr: Kako CRUSH smješta podatke i što grozd preživi kad mu dijelovi otkažu
concept.en: How CRUSH places data, and what a cluster survives when parts of it fail

summary.hr: Nacrtaj grozd, uredi CRUSH pravila i bazene, a zatim ruši diskove, domaćine i preklopnike: replikacija i EC, kvorum monitora, oporavak kroz vrijeme.
summary.en: Draw a cluster, edit its CRUSH rules and pools, then fail disks, hosts and switches: replication vs EC, monitor quorum, and recovery over time.

concept.hr: Najmanji razuman grozd: tri domaćina, tri replike, po jedan MON na svakom
concept.en: The smallest sensible cluster: three hosts, three replicas, a MON on each

concept.hr: Replike po ormarima, EC 4+2 po domaćinima: što preživi gubitak ormara?
concept.en: Replicas across racks, EC 4+2 across hosts: which survives a lost rack?

concept.hr: Domena kvara host: zdravo dok ne padne ormar, a onda PG-ovi stanu
concept.en: Failure domain host: healthy until a rack fails, then PGs go inactive

concept.hr: Jedan velik i dva mala domaćina: mali se pune prvi i ograničavaju grozd
concept.en: One big host, two small ones: the small ones fill first and cap the cluster
